Merger Agreement: SECTION 8.3. Evaluation of Proposals. <omitted> (e) Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, the Company Board may change its recommendation if, and only if, (i) the Company Board determines in good faith, after consultation with the Company’s outside legal counsel, that the failure to change its recommendation would be inconsistent with the fiduciary duties of the Company Board under applicable Law, (ii) the Company has given Parent written notice of the Company Board’s intention to change its recommendation not earlier than 11:59 p.m. New York time on the fourth Business Day after Parent receives such written notice and (iii) if not in connection with an Intervening Event pursuant to Section 8.3(f), the decision to change its recommendation is in connection with an Acquisition Proposal, and the Company shall have complied with clauses (1) through (4), as follows: (1) prior to giving effect to clauses (2) through (4), the Company Board shall have determined that all written communications relating to such Acquisition Proposal in accordance with Section 8.3(b), (3) the Company shall have negotiated in good faith with Parent (and caused its Representatives to negotiate with Parent), to the extent that Parent desires to negotiate, during the four Business Day period provided in the foregoing clause (ii) of this Section 8.3(e) with respect to such proposed Merger Agreement: SECTION 8.2. Board Evaluation. <omitted> (c) The Company Board may proceed with a Company Recommendation Change if, and only if, (i) the Company Board determines in good faith, after extensive consultation with the Company’s outside legal counsel, that maintaining the current recommendation would be inconsistent with the fiduciary duties of the Company Board under applicable Law, (ii) the Company has provided Parent a detailed written notice of the Company Board’s intention to make a Company Recommendation Change, including a comprehensive analysis of the legal and strategic implications of such a change, not less than seven Business Days before such a change, and (iii) the decision to proceed with the Company Recommendation Change is made in connection with an Acquisition Proposal that the Company Board, after considering the advice of a financial advisor of national reputation and the potential legal ramifications, deems a Superior Proposal. (Pages 82-83)
